input.content:
# Hedgerow

A third-person Second World War shooter for the browser — realistic-looking,
arcade to play. You are one soldier pushing through hand-built missions; this
proof of concept has the first one:

**Mission 1 — Saint-Clair, at dusk.** Normandy, July 1944, evening, rain.
Up a sunken lane between hedgerows, through the checkpoint into the village,
up the main street to the church square (sniper in the tower), over the
river (bridge under a machine gun, a ford downstream, a fallen tree
upstream), through the forest's foxholes and trench line, past a concrete
bunker, to the flak gun in the clearing — blow it up — and on to the rally
point.

Every defended point has more than one way past it: the orchard or the ditch
round the checkpoint, the back gardens or the ruined house along the street,
three river crossings, the ends of the trench, the flanks of the bunker.

## Controls

| | |
|---|---|
| Mouse | look and aim |
| W A S D | move |
| Shift | sprint |
| C / Ctrl | crouch (toggle) |
| Space | vault low cover / jump |
| Left / right button | fire / aim down the sights |
| R | reload |
| 1 / 2 / wheel | M1 Garand / Thompson |
| G | grenade (hold to cook) |
| E | use (set the charge) |
| Q | switch shoulder |
| Esc | pause |

Health comes back when you stay out of fire. Dying returns you to the last
checkpoint; the enemies you killed stay dead.

## How it is built

* `js/` — three.js r185 (the site's vendored copy), plain ES modules, no build.
  * `main.js` boot, menus, frame loop · `levelBuild.js` level data → world ·
    `levels/saint-clair.js` the mission (ground, props, enemies, objectives)
  * `terrain.js` heightfield + splat material · `world.js` colliders, rays,
    walking · `vegetation.js` instanced trees and ground cover with LOD
  * `player.js`, `camera.js`, `character.js` (rig, split upper/lower body
    animation), `combat.js` (hit volumes, grenades, charges), `ai.js`
    (perception, cover, MG nests, sniper), `mission.js`
  * `materials.js` palette-keyed wet materials · `sky.js`, `weather.js`
    (rain, splashes, lightning), `lights.js` (pooled point lights),
    `effects.js` (particles), `post.js` + `bloom.js`, `audio.js` (procedural)
* `assets/models/*.glb` — built by the Blender scripts in `tools/blender/`
  (see `tools/blender/notes/` and `docs/models-brief.md`):

      /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender --background --factory-startup \
          --python fun/hedgerow/tools/blender/build_<set>.py

  for `village`, `military`, `nature` and `soldier` (soldier + weapons).
* `assets/textures/*.webp` — tileable detail textures from
  `python3 fun/hedgerow/tools/textures.py`.
* `tests/world-check.mjs` — `node fun/hedgerow/tests/world-check.mjs`.

URL switches for testing: `?debug` (frame stats), `?god`, `?fly` (free
camera; WASD, Q/E, Shift), `?at=x,z` (start elsewhere), `?go` (straight to
the briefing).

Design notes: `docs/2026-10-19-hedgerow-design.md`.

content.content:
Side projects

Play in your browser.

Tyran

Ten extraordinary worlds. Swarming squadrons, power cores and wing drones to rescue.

Arcade shooter · 1 player Play game →

Ashline

Build a base, gather minerals and command an army through the fog of war.

Real-time strategy Play game →

Alpen

Carve, jump and link tricks on an endless mountain.

Snowboarding Play game →

Meteora

A ten-mission space-combat campaign: escort, scout, defend and strike in an asteroid belt.

Space combat Play game →
Company

Protocodus s.r.o.

- The interface uses normal-case labels and locally served Chakra Petch for a consistent space-console feel. ## Meteora [Play Meteora](fun/meteora/index.html) is a space-combat campaign in the spirit of FreeSpace, set in a dense asteroid belt around a red dwarf. Ten missions follow the Belt Watch's Lantern Wing from a missing ore tug to the evacuation of the whole belt, with briefings, a hangar, debriefs, medals, ranks and four difficulties. - The missions vary: patrol and first contact, convoy escort through a rockslide, stealth recon past sensor Eyes, destroying seeded asteroids, holding a station during an evacuation, guarding the carrier *Perpetua* under an eclipse, cutting an enemy supply line in open space, a fleet assault on a Mother-class capital ship, a convoy with a traitor, and a last battle around a colony ark until it jumps — plus a special operation, a rescue from a convoy falling into a black hole (drawn with real gravitational lensing). Every place has its own sky, light and dust, and the story is uncovered clue by clue in a case file. Flight training teaches the basics first. - Choose an interceptor, a fighter or a bomber, a gun, missiles or torpedoes and a reactor; every mission recommends a loadout and says why, and the hangar warns when a choice will not do the job. - Steer with the mouse or a gamepad (adjustable sensitivity, self-centring or stick-like steering, rebindable keys). Quadrant shields, a low-hull alarm and a repair drone on R keep you flying; the nearest hostile is targeted by itself and pictured in a target panel; wing orders, subsystem targeting and torpedo interception are a key away. Rocks collide by their real shapes. - The ships, stations and capital ships are built by committed Blender scripts with baked textures, and their turrets, bays, subsystems and lights come from the models. - Synthesised 3D sound, live generated music and a voiced radio (the browser's own speech synthesis reads the radio, the briefings and the debriefs); every mission opens and closes on a camera shot, and the big moments get cutaways. Survival mode keeps the old endless waves. - See the [game guide](fun/meteora/README.md) for the controls, the campaign, the armoury, the model pipeline and the checks. fun/index.html:9: content="Play Tyran, Ashline, Alpen and Meteora: browser arcade shooting, strategy, snowboarding and space combat.     bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
    bpy.ops.mesh.select_all(action='SELECT')
    bpy.ops.uv.smart_project(angle_limit=math.radians(angle), island_margin=margin,
                             area_weight=0.6, correct_aspect=True)

    obj.data.materials.append(mat)

    if key in ch and ch[key] is not None:
        return ch[key]
    return {'albedo': (0.5, 0.5, 0.5), 'rough': 0.5, 'metal': 0.0, 'glow': (0, 0, 0)}[key]


def bake(target, image, kind='NORMAL', channel=None, sources=(), extrusion=0.0,
         max_ray=0.0, margin=8, samples=None):
    """Bake into `image` on `target`. kind 'NORMAL' bakes the tangent-space
    shading normal; channel='albedo'|'rough'|'metal'|'glow' bakes that
    channel of the source materials through an emission override. With
    `sources`, bakes selected-to-active from those objects."""
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    if samples is not None:
        scene.cycles.samples = samples
    shaders = list(sources) or [target]
    added, restore = [], []
    for slot in target.material_slots:
        if slot.material is None:
            continue
        nt = slot.material.node_tree
        tex = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage')
        tex.image = image
        nt.nodes.active = tex
        added.append((nt, tex))
    if channel:
        seen = set()
        for obj in shaders:
            for slot in obj.material_slots:
                mat = slot.material
                if mat is None or mat.name in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(mat.name)
                nt = mat.node_tree
                out = next(n for n in nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == 'ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')
                old = out.inputs['Surface'].links[0].from_socket if out.inputs['Surface'].links else None
                em = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeEmission')
                val = _channel_value(CHANNELS.get(mat.name, {}), channel)
                if isinstance(val, bpy.types.NodeSocket):
                    nt.links.new(val, em.inputs['Color'])
                else:
                    em.inputs['Color'].default_value = (tuple(val) + (1.0,)) if hasattr(val, '__len__') \
                        else (val, val, val, 1.0)
                em.inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
                nt.links.new(em.outputs[0], out.inputs['Surface'])
                restore.append((nt, out, old, em))
    activate(target, sources)
    bpy.ops.object.bake(type='EMIT' if channel else kind, margin=margin, margin_type='EXTEND',
                        use_selected_to_active=bool(sources), cage_extrusion=extrusion,
                        max_ray_distance=max_ray, use_clear=True, target='IMAGE_TEXTURES')
    for nt, out, old, em in restore:
        nt.nodes.remove(em)
        if old is not None:
            nt.links.new(old, out.inputs['Surface'])
    for nt, tex in added:
        nt.nodes.remove(tex)


def pixels(img):
    a = np.empty(len(img.pixels), np.float32)
    img.pixels.foreach_get(a)
    return a.reshape(img.size[1], img.size[0], 4)


def set_pixels(img, arr):
    img.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(arr, np.float32).ravel())
    img.update()


def pack_mr(name, rough, metal=None):
    """glTF metallic-roughness: G = roughness, B = metallic (R unused, 1)."""
    size = rough.size[0]
    img = new_image(name, size, non_color=True)
    r = pixels(rough)
    out = np.ones_like(r)
    out[..., 1] = r[..., 0]
    out[..., 2] = pixels(metal)[..., 0] if metal is not None else 0.0
    set_pixels(img, out)
    return img


def baked_material(name, base, normal, mr, emissive=None, uv='UVMap'):
    """Principled material wired to the baked images (what the glTF
    exporter reads): base colour, tangent-space normal map, packed
    metallic-roughness and an optional emissive map."""
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    g = Graph(mat)
    tb = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=base)
    tn = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=normal)
    tm = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=mr)
    nm = g.node('ShaderNodeNormalMap', [1.0, tn.outputs['Color']], space='TANGENT', uv_map=uv)
    sep = g.node('ShaderNodeSeparateColor', [tm.outputs['Color']])
    bsdf = g.principled(tb.outputs['Color'], sep.outputs['Green'], sep.outputs['Blue'], nm.outputs[0])
    if emissive is not None:
        te = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=emissive)
        g.feed(bsdf.inputs['Emission Color'], te.outputs['Color'])
        g.feed(bsdf.inputs['Emission Strength'], 1.0)
    return mat


def flat_material(name, color, rough, metal, emission=None, strength=1.0, alpha=1.0):
    """An untextured Principled material (glTF factors only)."""
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    g = Graph(mat)
    bsdf = g.principled(color, rough, metal, None, emission)
    if emission is not None:
        g.feed(bsdf.inputs['Emission Strength'], strength)
    if alpha < 1.0:
        g.feed(bsdf.inputs['Alpha'], alpha)
    return mat


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export

def export_glb(path, objects):
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    for o in objects:
        o.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = objects[0]
    bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(
        filepath=path, export_format='GLB', use_selection=True,
        export_yup=True, export_apply=True, export_image_format='WEBP',
        export_image_quality=82, export_extras=False, export_cameras=False,
        export_lights=False, export_tangents=True, export_animations=False,
        export_vertex_color='NONE')
    log('wrote', os.path.relpath(path, ROOT), f'{os.path.getsize(path) / 1024:.0f} KB')


def to_gltf(v):
    """Blender (x, y, z) -> glTF (x, z, -y) for the +Y-up export."""
    return (v[0], v[2], -v[1])

    out[..., 1] = r[..., 0]

        export_lights=False, export_tangents=True, export_animations=False,

def to_gltf(v):

"""Hedgerow — realistic PBR bakes (models v2).

A model built with kit.py (palette-keyed materials, box UVs in metres
`UVMap`, origin at its base) goes through `bake_model()`:

1. a fresh atlas unwrap into a `bake` UV layer (smart project + pack);
2. ambient occlusion baked from the model itself and a ground plane under
   it (contact darkening) — the AO image;
3. an edge mask: how far the Cycles Bevel normal leans from the true normal,
   i.e. where edges are — the EDGE image (paint chips, worn edges, dust);
4. every palette material replaced by its procedural surface from
   `surfaces.py` (stone courses, mortar, peeling paint, rust, burlap, wool,
   bark, moss, grime, rain streaks...), which reads the AO and EDGE images;
5. base colour, roughness, metallic and emission baked through an emission
   override (noise-free, one sample), the tangent-space normal baked from the
   surfaces' bump plus rounded bevelled edges;
6. one Principled material wired to the images (base colour, normal, packed
   metallic-roughness, optional emissive); the `bake` UVs become `UVMap` so
   they export as TEXCOORD_0.

Export with `kit.export(..., images=True)` (WebP inside the GLB).

    bake.bake_model(obj, tpm=110)          # texels per metre
    bake.bake_model(obj, size=1024)        # or a fixed size

Set HEDGEROW_FAST=1 for quick iterations (small images, few samples).
Deterministic: fixed seeds; Cycles seed fixed by kit.reset().
"""
import bpy, bmesh, math, os, time
import numpy as np
from mathutils import Vector

import kit

FAST = bool(os.environ.get('HEDGEROW_FAST'))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A small shader-graph builder (after fun/meteora/tools/blender/common.py)

class Graph:
    """Helpers over a material node tree. Inputs may be numbers, colours,
    sockets or nodes; every helper returns an output socket."""

    def __init__(self, mat, clear=True):
        self.mat = mat
        mat.use_nodes = True
        self.nt = mat.node_tree
        if clear:
            for n in list(self.nt.nodes):
                self.nt.nodes.remove(n)
        self.output = next((n for n in self.nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == 'ShaderNodeOutputMaterial'), None) \
            or self.nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')

    def feed(self, sock, val):
        if val is None:
            return
        if isinstance(val, bpy.types.Node):
            val = val.outputs[0]
        if isinstance(val, bpy.types.NodeSocket):
            self.nt.links.new(val, sock)
            return
        dv = sock.default_value
        if isinstance(val, (int, float)) and hasattr(dv, '__len__'):
            val = [val] * len(dv)
            if len(dv) == 4:
                val[3] = 1.0
        elif hasattr(dv, '__len__') and len(dv) == 4 and len(val) == 3:
            val = list(val) + [1.0]
        sock.default_value = val

    def node(self, kind, inputs=None, **props):
        n = self.nt.nodes.new(kind)
        for k, v in props.items():
            setattr(n, k, v)
        if inputs:
            items = inputs.items() if isinstance(inputs, dict) else enumerate(inputs)
            for key, val in items:
                self.feed(n.inputs[key], val)
        return n

    # inputs
    def coord(self, kind='Object'):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeTexCoord').outputs[kind]

    def uvmap(self, name):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeUVMap', uv_map=name).outputs['UV']

    def geometry(self, kind):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeNewGeometry').outputs[kind]

    def attribute(self, name, kind='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeAttribute', attribute_name=name)
        return n.outputs[kind]

    def image(self, img, uv='bake', out='Color'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=img, interpolation='Linear')
        self.nt.links.new(self.uvmap(uv), n.inputs['Vector'])
        return n.outputs[out]

    # arithmetic
    def math(self, op, a, b=None, c=None, clamp=False):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMath', operation=op, use_clamp=clamp)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[1], b)
        self.feed(n.inputs[2], c)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def add(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('ADD', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def sub(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('SUBTRACT', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def mul(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('MULTIPLY', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def madd(self, a, b, c, clamp=False): return self.math('MULTIPLY_ADD', a, b, c, clamp=clamp)
    def maximum(self, a, b): return self.math('MAXIMUM', a, b)
    def minimum(self, a, b): return self.math('MINIMUM', a, b)
    def power(self, a, b): return self.math('POWER', a, b)
    def absolute(self, a): return self.math('ABSOLUTE', a)
    def sin(self, a): return self.math('SINE', a)
    def fract(self, a): return self.math('FRACT', a)
    def floor(self, a): return self.math('FLOOR', a)
    def one_minus(self, a): return self.math('SUBTRACT', 1.0, a)

    def vmath(self, op, a, b=None, scale=None, out=0):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeVectorMath', operation=op)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[1], b)
        if scale is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def vscale(self, v, s):
        """Component-wise scale: s is a number or an (x, y, z) tuple."""
        if isinstance(s, (int, float)):
            return self.vmath('SCALE', v, scale=s)
        return self.vmath('MULTIPLY', v, tuple(s))

    def vadd(self, v, o):
        return self.vmath('ADD', v, tuple(o) if not isinstance(o, bpy.types.NodeSocket) else o)

    def sep(self, v):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ', [v])
        return n.outputs[0], n.outputs[1], n.outputs[2]

    def combine(self, x, y, z):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeCombineXYZ', [x, y, z]).outputs[0]

    def map_range(self, x, a, b, c=0.0, d=1.0, interp='LINEAR', clamp=True):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMapRange', interpolation_type=interp, clamp=clamp)
        for i, v in enumerate((x, a, b, c, d)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[i], v)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def smooth(self, x, a, b):
        return self.map_range(x, a, b, 0.0, 1.0, interp='SMOOTHSTEP')

    def mix(self, fac, a, b, blend='MIX'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMix', data_type='RGBA', blend_type=blend, clamp_factor=True)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        self.feed(n.inputs[6], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[7], b)
        return n.outputs[2]

    def mixf(self, fac, a, b):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMix', data_type='FLOAT', clamp_factor=True)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        self.feed(n.inputs[2], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[3], b)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def cmul(self, a, b):
        return self.mix(1.0, a, b, blend='MULTIPLY')

    def ramp(self, fac, stops, interp='LINEAR'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        cr = n.color_ramp
        cr.interpolation = interp
        while len(cr.elements) > len(stops):
            cr.elements.remove(cr.elements[-1])
        while len(cr.elements) < len(stops):
            cr.elements.new(0.5)
        for el, (pos, col) in zip(cr.elements, stops):
            el.position = pos
            el.color = tuple(col) + ((1.0,) if len(col) == 3 else ())
        return n.outputs[0]

    def hsv(self, col, h=0.5, s=1.0, v=1.0):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeHueSaturation', {'Hue': h, 'Saturation': s, 'Value': v, 'Fac': 1.0, 'Color': col}).outputs[0]

    # textures
    def noise(self, vec, scale, detail=4.0, rough=0.5, distortion=0.0, kind='FBM', lac=2.0, out='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexNoise', noise_type=kind, noise_dimensions='3D')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        for k, v in (('Scale', scale), ('Detail', detail), ('Roughness', rough),
                     ('Lacunarity', lac), ('Distortion', distortion)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[k], v)
        return n.outputs['Fac' if out in ('Fac', 'Factor') else out]

    def voronoi(self, vec, scale, feature='F1', rand=1.0, out='Distance', smooth=0.0, dims='3D', metric='EUCLIDEAN'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexVoronoi', feature=feature, voronoi_dimensions=dims, distance=metric)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Randomness'], rand)
        if feature == 'SMOOTH_F1':
            self.feed(n.inputs['Smoothness'], smooth)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def voronoi_edge(self, vec, scale, rand=1.0, dims='3D'):
        """Distance to the nearest cell border (0 on the border)."""
        return self.voronoi(vec, scale, feature='DISTANCE_TO_EDGE', rand=rand, dims=dims)

    def brick(self, vec, scale, mortar, width=0.5, height=0.25, bias=0.0, smooth=0.1, offset=0.5, out='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexBrick', offset=offset, squash=1.0)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        for k, v in (('Scale', scale), ('Mortar Size', mortar), ('Mortar Smooth', smooth),
                     ('Bias', bias), ('Brick Width', width), ('Row Height', height)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[k], v)
        n.inputs['Color1'].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
        n.inputs['Color2'].default_value = (0, 0, 0, 1)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def wave(self, vec, scale, kind='BANDS', direction='X', distortion=0.0, detail=2.0, profile='SIN'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexWave', wave_type=kind, bands_direction=direction, wave_profile=profile)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Distortion'], distortion)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Detail'], detail)
        return n.outputs['Fac']

    def bump(self, height, strength=1.0, distance=0.02, normal=None):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBump')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Height'], height)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Strength'], strength)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Distance'], distance)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Normal'], normal)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def bevel(self, radius, samples=8):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBevel', samples=samples)
        n.inputs['Radius'].default_value = radius
        return n.outputs[0]

    def emission(self, col):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeEmission')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Color'], col)
        n.inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
        self.nt.links.new(n.outputs[0], self.output.inputs['Surface'])
        return n

    def principled(self, albedo, rough, metal, normal=None, glow=None, alpha=None):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Base Color'], albedo)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Roughness'], rough)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Metallic'], metal)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Normal'], normal)
        if glow is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Emission Color'], glow)
            self.feed(n.inputs['Emission Strength'], 1.0)
        if alpha is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Alpha'], alpha)
        self.nt.links.new(n.outputs[0], self.output.inputs['Surface'])
        return n


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Images

def new_image(name, size, non_color=False, alpha=False):
    old = bpy.data.images.get(name)
    if old:
        bpy.data.images.remove(old)
    img = bpy.data.images.new(name, size, size, alpha=alpha, float_buffer=False)
    if non_color:
        img.colorspace_settings.name = 'Non-Color'
    return img


def pixels(img):
    a = np.empty(len(img.pixels), np.float32)
    img.pixels.foreach_get(a)
    return a.reshape(img.size[1], img.size[0], 4)


def set_pixels(img, arr):
    img.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(arr, np.float32).ravel())
    img.update()
    img.pack()


def blur_image(img, r=1):
    a = pixels(img)
    out = a.copy()
    acc = np.zeros_like(a)
    n = 0
    for dy in range(-r, r + 1):
        for dx in range(-r, r + 1):
            acc += np.roll(np.roll(a, dy, 0), dx, 1)
            n += 1
    out[..., :3] = acc[..., :3] / n
    set_pixels(img, out)
    return img


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UVs

def unwrap(obj, margin=0.004, angle=62.0):
    """A fresh atlas unwrap into a `bake` UV layer (kept beside `UVMap`)."""
    me = obj.data
    if 'bake' in me.uv_layers:
        me.uv_layers.remove(me.uv_layers['bake'])
    lay = me.uv_layers.new(name='bake')
    me.uv_layers.active = lay
    kit.activate(obj)
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
    bpy.ops.mesh.select_all(action='SELECT')
    bpy.ops.uv.smart_project(angle_limit=math.radians(angle), island_margin=margin,
                             area_weight=0.0, correct_aspect=True, scale_to_bounds=False)
    bpy.ops.uv.select_all(action='SELECT')
    try:
        bpy.ops.uv.pack_islands(rotate=True, rotate_method='ANY', shape_method='CONCAVE',
                                margin_method='FRACTION', margin=margin)
    except TypeError:
        bpy.ops.uv.pack_islands(rotate=True, margin=margin)
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
    return lay


def finish_uvs(obj):
    """After baking: the atlas becomes the only UV layer, named UVMap."""
    me = obj.data
    for lay in list(me.uv_layers):
        if lay.name != 'bake':
            me.uv_layers.remove(lay)
    me.uv_layers['bake'].name = 'UVMap'
    me.uv_layers.active = me.uv_layers['UVMap']
    me.uv_layers['UVMap'].active_render = True


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baking

def _isolate(objs):
    """Hide every other renderable object while baking these."""
    keep = set(objs)
    hidden = []
    for o in bpy.context.scene.objects:
        if o in keep or o.type not in ('MESH', 'CURVE'):
            continue
        if not o.hide_render:
            o.hide_render = True
            hidden.append(o)
    return hidden


def _restore(hidden):
    for o in hidden:
        o.hide_render = False


def _bake(obj, image, kind, samples, margin=6):
    """Bake into `image` with every material of `obj` holding it as the
    active image node."""
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    scene.cycles.samples = samples
    scene.render.bake.margin = margin
    scene.render.bake.margin_type = 'EXTEND'
    scene.render.bake.use_clear = True
    scene.render.bake.normal_space = 'TANGENT'
    scene.render.bake.target = 'IMAGE_TEXTURES'
    added = []
    for slot in obj.material_slots:
        mat = slot.material
        if mat is None:
            continue
        nt = mat.node_tree
        tex = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage')
        tex.image = image
        uvn = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeUVMap')
        uvn.uv_map = 'bake'
        nt.links.new(uvn.outputs['UV'], tex.inputs['Vector'])
        nt.nodes.active = tex
        tex.select = True
        added.append((nt, tex, uvn))
    kit.activate(obj)
    obj.data.uv_layers.active = obj.data.uv_layers['bake']
    if kind == 'AO':
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='AO', margin=margin, use_clear=True)
    elif kind == 'NORMAL':
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='NORMAL', margin=margin, use_clear=True, normal_space='TANGENT')
    else:
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='EMIT', margin=margin, use_clear=True)
    for nt, tex, uvn in added:
        nt.nodes.remove(tex)
        nt.nodes.remove(uvn)
    image.pack()


def _flat_override(obj, build):
    """Temporarily give every slot an emission material built by
    `build(graph)`; returns a restore function."""
    originals = [s.material for s in obj.material_slots]
    tmp = bpy.data.materials.new(obj.name + '_tmp')
    g = Graph(tmp)
    build(g)
    for s in obj.material_slots:
        s.material = tmp

    def restore():
        for s, m in zip(obj.material_slots, originals):
            s.material = m
        bpy.data.materials.remove(tmp)
    return restore


def size_for(obj, tpm, lo=256, hi=2048):
    area = sum(p.area for p in obj.data.polygons)
    side = math.sqrt(max(area, 1e-4) * 0.62) * tpm     # ~62% of the atlas is used
    size = 2 ** int(round(math.log2(max(side, lo))))
    return int(max(lo, min(hi, size)))


def bake_model(obj, tpm=110, size=None, ao_distance=0.6, ground=True, bevel=0.012,
               normal_size=None, ao_strength=1.0, emissive=True, seed=None, keep_slots=False,
               samples_ao=32, samples_edge=12, samples_normal=8):
    """Turn a palette-material model into a textured PBR model in place.
    Returns a dict of the images."""
    import surfaces
    t0 = time.time()
    if size is None:
        size = size_for(obj, tpm)
    if FAST:
        size = min(size, 256)
        samples_ao, samples_edge, samples_normal = 4, 2, 1
    nsize = normal_size or size
    name = obj.name
    keys = [(s.material.name if s.material else 'stone') for s in obj.material_slots]
    keys = [k.split('.')[0] for k in keys]
    if not obj.data.uv_layers.get('UVMap'):
        kit.uv_box(obj)
        obj.data.uv_layers[-1].name = 'UVMap'
    unwrap(obj)

    hidden = _isolate([obj])
    plane = None
    if ground:
        mn, mx = kit.bounds(obj)
        span = max(mx.x - mn.x, mx.y - mn.y) * 2 + 4
        plane = kit.plane(span, span, loc=((mn.x + mx.x) / 2, (mn.y + mx.y) / 2, mn.z + 0.002), mat='dirt', name=name + '_ground')
        if mn.z < -0.05:       # sunk rocks: the ground at z = 0
            plane.location.z = 0.0
    world = bpy.context.scene.world or bpy.data.worlds.new('bake_world')
    bpy.context.scene.world = world
    world.use_nodes = True
    world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Color'].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
    world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
    bpy.context.scene.world.light_settings.distance = ao_distance

    # 2. ambient occlusion
    ao = new_image(name + '_ao', size, non_color=True)
    restore = _flat_override(obj, lambda g: g.emission((1, 1, 1)))
    _bake(obj, ao, 'AO', samples_ao)
    restore()
    if plane:
        kit.delete(plane)
    # 3. edge mask from the bevel normal
    edge = new_image(name + '_edge', size, non_color=True)

    def edge_graph(g):
        bev = g.bevel(bevel * 2.5, samples=8)
        n = g.geometry('Normal')
        d = g.vmath('DOT_PRODUCT', bev, n, out=1)
        e = g.map_range(d, 0.995, 0.75, 0.0, 1.0)
        g.emission(g.combine(e, e, e))
    restore = _flat_override(obj, edge_graph)
    _bake(obj, edge, 'EMIT', samples_edge)
    restore()
    blur_image(edge, 1)

    # 4. procedural surfaces
    rnd_seed = seed if seed is not None else (sum(ord(c) for c in name) % 997)
    mats = []
    for k in keys:
        mats.append(surfaces.surface_material(k, ao, edge, seed=rnd_seed, bevel=bevel))
    for slot, m in zip(obj.material_slots, mats):
        slot.material = m

    # 5. channels
    base = new_image(name + '_base', size)
    rough = new_image(name + '_rough', size, non_color=True)
    metal = new_image(name + '_metal', size, non_color=True)
    normal = new_image(name + '_normal', nsize, non_color=True)
    has_glow = emissive and any(surfaces.has_glow(k) for k in keys)
    glow = new_image(name + '_glow', max(256, size // 2)) if has_glow else None

    for img, ch in ((base, 'albedo'), (rough, 'rough'), (metal, 'metal')) + (((glow, 'glow'),) if glow else ()):
        surfaces.route(mats, ch)
        _bake(obj, img, 'EMIT', 1)
    surfaces.route(mats, None)
    _bake(obj, normal, 'NORMAL', samples_normal)

    # 6. the final material
    mr = new_image(name + '_mr', size, non_color=True)
    r, m = pixels(rough), pixels(metal)
    out = np.ones_like(r)
    out[..., 1] = r[..., 0]
    out[..., 2] = m[..., 0]
    set_pixels(mr, out)
    for img in (base, normal):
        img.pack()
    final = baked_material(name, base, normal, mr, glow)
    obj.data.materials.clear()
    obj.data.materials.append(final)
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        p.material_index = 0
    finish_uvs(obj)
    # vertex colours are now in the textures
    kit.flat_color(obj, 1.0)
    for m_ in mats:
        bpy.data.materials.remove(m_)
    for img in (rough, metal):
        bpy.data.images.remove(img)
    _restore(hidden)
    kit.log(f'baked {name}: {size}px ({nsize}px normal){" +glow" if glow else ""} in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s')
    return {'base': base, 'normal': normal, 'mr': mr, 'glow': glow, 'ao': ao, 'edge': edge}


def baked_material(name, base, normal, mr, emissive=None, alpha=False):
    """Principled material wired to baked images (what the glTF exporter reads)."""
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    g = Graph(mat)
    tb = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=base)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tb.inputs['Vector'])
    tn = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=normal)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tn.inputs['Vector'])
    tm = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=mr)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tm.inputs['Vector'])
    nm = g.node('ShaderNodeNormalMap', space='TANGENT', uv_map='bake')
    g.nt.links.new(tn.outputs['Color'], nm.inputs['Color'])
    sep = g.node('ShaderNodeSeparateColor')
    g.nt.links.new(tm.outputs['Color'], sep.inputs['Color'])
    bsdf = g.principled(tb.outputs['Color'], sep.outputs['Green'], sep.outputs['Blue'], nm.outputs[0],
                        alpha=tb.outputs['Alpha'] if alpha else None)
    if emissive is not None:
        te = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=emissive)
        g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), te.inputs['Vector'])
        g.feed(bsdf.inputs['Emission Color'], te.outputs['Color'])
        g.feed(bsdf.inputs['Emission Strength'], 1.0)
    if alpha:
        mat.blend_method = 'CLIP' if hasattr(mat, 'blend_method') else None
    return mat

"""Hedgerow — realistic PBR bakes (models v2).

A model built with kit.py (palette-keyed materials, box UVs in metres
`UVMap`, origin at its base) goes through `bake_model()`:

1. a fresh atlas unwrap into a `bake` UV layer (smart project + pack);
2. ambient occlusion baked from the model itself and a ground plane under
   it (contact darkening) — the AO image;
3. an edge mask: how far the Cycles Bevel normal leans from the true normal,
   i.e. where edges are — the EDGE image (paint chips, worn edges, dust);
4. every palette material replaced by its procedural surface from
   `surfaces.py` (stone courses, mortar, peeling paint, rust, burlap, wool,
   bark, moss, grime, rain streaks...), which reads the AO and EDGE images;
5. base colour, roughness, metallic and emission baked through an emission
   override (noise-free, one sample), the tangent-space normal baked from the
   surfaces' bump plus rounded bevelled edges;
6. one Principled material wired to the images (base colour, normal, packed
   metallic-roughness, optional emissive); the `bake` UVs become `UVMap` so
   they export as TEXCOORD_0.

Export with `kit.export(..., images=True)` (WebP inside the GLB).

    bake.bake_model(obj, tpm=110)          # texels per metre
    bake.bake_model(obj, size=1024)        # or a fixed size

Set HEDGEROW_FAST=1 for quick iterations (small images, few samples).
Deterministic: fixed seeds; Cycles seed fixed by kit.reset().
"""
import bpy, bmesh, math, os, time
import numpy as np
from mathutils import Vector

import kit

FAST = bool(os.environ.get('HEDGEROW_FAST'))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A small shader-graph builder (after fun/meteora/tools/blender/common.py)

class Graph:
    """Helpers over a material node tree. Inputs may be numbers, colours,
    sockets or nodes; every helper returns an output socket."""

    def __init__(self, mat, clear=True):
        self.mat = mat
        mat.use_nodes = True
        self.nt = mat.node_tree
        if clear:
            for n in list(self.nt.nodes):
                self.nt.nodes.remove(n)
        self.output = next((n for n in self.nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == 'ShaderNodeOutputMaterial'), None) \
            or self.nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')

    def feed(self, sock, val):
        if val is None:
            return
        if isinstance(val, bpy.types.Node):
            val = val.outputs[0]
        if isinstance(val, bpy.types.NodeSocket):
            self.nt.links.new(val, sock)
            return
        dv = sock.default_value
        if isinstance(val, (int, float)) and hasattr(dv, '__len__'):
            val = [val] * len(dv)
            if len(dv) == 4:
                val[3] = 1.0
        elif hasattr(dv, '__len__') and len(dv) == 4 and len(val) == 3:
            val = list(val) + [1.0]
        sock.default_value = val

    def node(self, kind, inputs=None, **props):
        n = self.nt.nodes.new(kind)
        for k, v in props.items():
            setattr(n, k, v)
        if inputs:
            items = inputs.items() if isinstance(inputs, dict) else enumerate(inputs)
            for key, val in items:
                self.feed(n.inputs[key], val)
        return n

    # inputs
    def coord(self, kind='Object'):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeTexCoord').outputs[kind]

    def uvmap(self, name):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeUVMap', uv_map=name).outputs['UV']

    def geometry(self, kind):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeNewGeometry').outputs[kind]

    def attribute(self, name, kind='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeAttribute', attribute_name=name)
        return n.outputs[kind]

    def image(self, img, uv='bake', out='Color'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=img, interpolation='Linear')
        self.nt.links.new(self.uvmap(uv), n.inputs['Vector'])
        return n.outputs[out]

    # arithmetic
    def math(self, op, a, b=None, c=None, clamp=False):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMath', operation=op, use_clamp=clamp)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[1], b)
        self.feed(n.inputs[2], c)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def add(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('ADD', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def sub(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('SUBTRACT', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def mul(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('MULTIPLY', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def madd(self, a, b, c, clamp=False): return self.math('MULTIPLY_ADD', a, b, c, clamp=clamp)
    def maximum(self, a, b): return self.math('MAXIMUM', a, b)
    def minimum(self, a, b): return self.math('MINIMUM', a, b)
    def power(self, a, b): return self.math('POWER', a, b)
    def absolute(self, a): return self.math('ABSOLUTE', a)
    def sin(self, a): return self.math('SINE', a)
    def fract(self, a): return self.math('FRACT', a)
    def floor(self, a): return self.math('FLOOR', a)
    def one_minus(self, a): return self.math('SUBTRACT', 1.0, a)

    def vmath(self, op, a, b=None, scale=None, out=0):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeVectorMath', operation=op)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[1], b)
        if scale is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def vscale(self, v, s):
        """Component-wise scale: s is a number or an (x, y, z) tuple."""
        if isinstance(s, (int, float)):
            return self.vmath('SCALE', v, scale=s)
        return self.vmath('MULTIPLY', v, tuple(s))

    def vadd(self, v, o):
        return self.vmath('ADD', v, tuple(o) if not isinstance(o, bpy.types.NodeSocket) else o)

    def sep(self, v):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ', [v])
        return n.outputs[0], n.outputs[1], n.outputs[2]

    def combine(self, x, y, z):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeCombineXYZ', [x, y, z]).outputs[0]

    def map_range(self, x, a, b, c=0.0, d=1.0, interp='LINEAR', clamp=True):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMapRange', interpolation_type=interp, clamp=clamp)
        for i, v in enumerate((x, a, b, c, d)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[i], v)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def smooth(self, x, a, b):
        return self.map_range(x, a, b, 0.0, 1.0, interp='SMOOTHSTEP')

    def mix(self, fac, a, b, blend='MIX'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMix', data_type='RGBA', blend_type=blend, clamp_factor=True)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        self.feed(n.inputs[6], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[7], b)
        return n.outputs[2]

    def mixf(self, fac, a, b):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMix', data_type='FLOAT', clamp_factor=True)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        self.feed(n.inputs[2], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[3], b)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def cmul(self, a, b):
        return self.mix(1.0, a, b, blend='MULTIPLY')

    def ramp(self, fac, stops, interp='LINEAR'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        cr = n.color_ramp
        cr.interpolation = interp
        while len(cr.elements) > len(stops):
            cr.elements.remove(cr.elements[-1])
        while len(cr.elements) < len(stops):
            cr.elements.new(0.5)
        for el, (pos, col) in zip(cr.elements, stops):
            el.position = pos
            el.color = tuple(col) + ((1.0,) if len(col) == 3 else ())
        return n.outputs[0]

    def hsv(self, col, h=0.5, s=1.0, v=1.0):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeHueSaturation', {'Hue': h, 'Saturation': s, 'Value': v, 'Fac': 1.0, 'Color': col}).outputs[0]

    # textures
    def noise(self, vec, scale, detail=4.0, rough=0.5, distortion=0.0, kind='FBM', lac=2.0, out='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexNoise', noise_type=kind, noise_dimensions='3D')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        for k, v in (('Scale', scale), ('Detail', detail), ('Roughness', rough),
                     ('Lacunarity', lac), ('Distortion', distortion)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[k], v)
        return n.outputs['Fac' if out in ('Fac', 'Factor') else out]

    def voronoi(self, vec, scale, feature='F1', rand=1.0, out='Distance', smooth=0.0, dims='3D', metric='EUCLIDEAN'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexVoronoi', feature=feature, voronoi_dimensions=dims, distance=metric)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Randomness'], rand)
        if feature == 'SMOOTH_F1':
            self.feed(n.inputs['Smoothness'], smooth)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def voronoi_edge(self, vec, scale, rand=1.0, dims='3D'):
        """Distance to the nearest cell border (0 on the border)."""
        return self.voronoi(vec, scale, feature='DISTANCE_TO_EDGE', rand=rand, dims=dims)

    def brick(self, vec, scale, mortar, width=0.5, height=0.25, bias=0.0, smooth=0.1, offset=0.5, out='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexBrick', offset=offset, squash=1.0)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        for k, v in (('Scale', scale), ('Mortar Size', mortar), ('Mortar Smooth', smooth),
                     ('Bias', bias), ('Brick Width', width), ('Row Height', height)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[k], v)
        n.inputs['Color1'].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
        n.inputs['Color2'].default_value = (0, 0, 0, 1)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def wave(self, vec, scale, kind='BANDS', direction='X', distortion=0.0, detail=2.0, profile='SIN'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexWave', wave_type=kind, bands_direction=direction, wave_profile=profile)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Distortion'], distortion)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Detail'], detail)
        return n.outputs['Fac']

    def bump(self, height, strength=1.0, distance=0.02, normal=None):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBump')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Height'], height)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Strength'], strength)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Distance'], distance)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Normal'], normal)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def bevel(self, radius, samples=8):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBevel', samples=samples)
        n.inputs['Radius'].default_value = radius
        return n.outputs[0]

    def emission(self, col):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeEmission')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Color'], col)
        n.inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
        self.nt.links.new(n.outputs[0], self.output.inputs['Surface'])
        return n

    def principled(self, albedo, rough, metal, normal=None, glow=None, alpha=None):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Base Color'], albedo)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Roughness'], rough)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Metallic'], metal)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Normal'], normal)
        if glow is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Emission Color'], glow)
            self.feed(n.inputs['Emission Strength'], 1.0)
        if alpha is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Alpha'], alpha)
        self.nt.links.new(n.outputs[0], self.output.inputs['Surface'])
        return n


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Images

def new_image(name, size, non_color=False, alpha=False):
    old = bpy.data.images.get(name)
    if old:
        bpy.data.images.remove(old)
    img = bpy.data.images.new(name, size, size, alpha=alpha, float_buffer=False)
    if non_color:
        img.colorspace_settings.name = 'Non-Color'
    return img


def pixels(img):
    a = np.empty(len(img.pixels), np.float32)
    img.pixels.foreach_get(a)
    return a.reshape(img.size[1], img.size[0], 4)


def set_pixels(img, arr):
    img.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(arr, np.float32).ravel())
    img.update()
    img.pack()


def blur_image(img, r=1):
    a = pixels(img)
    out = a.copy()
    acc = np.zeros_like(a)
    n = 0
    for dy in range(-r, r + 1):
        for dx in range(-r, r + 1):
            acc += np.roll(np.roll(a, dy, 0), dx, 1)
            n += 1
    out[..., :3] = acc[..., :3] / n
    set_pixels(img, out)
    return img


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UVs

def unwrap(obj, margin=0.004, angle=62.0):
    """A fresh atlas unwrap into a `bake` UV layer (kept beside `UVMap`)."""
    me = obj.data
    if 'bake' in me.uv_layers:
        me.uv_layers.remove(me.uv_layers['bake'])
    lay = me.uv_layers.new(name='bake')
    me.uv_layers.active = lay
    kit.activate(obj)
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
    bpy.ops.mesh.select_all(action='SELECT')
    bpy.ops.uv.smart_project(angle_limit=math.radians(angle), island_margin=margin,
                             area_weight=0.0, correct_aspect=True, scale_to_bounds=False)
    bpy.ops.uv.select_all(action='SELECT')
    try:
        bpy.ops.uv.pack_islands(rotate=True, rotate_method='ANY', shape_method='CONCAVE',
                                margin_method='FRACTION', margin=margin)
    except TypeError:
        bpy.ops.uv.pack_islands(rotate=True, margin=margin)
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
    return lay


def finish_uvs(obj):
    """After baking: the atlas becomes the only UV layer, named UVMap."""
    me = obj.data
    for lay in list(me.uv_layers):
        if lay.name != 'bake':
            me.uv_layers.remove(lay)
    me.uv_layers['bake'].name = 'UVMap'
    me.uv_layers.active = me.uv_layers['UVMap']
    me.uv_layers['UVMap'].active_render = True


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baking

def _isolate(objs):
    """Hide every other renderable object while baking these."""
    keep = set(objs)
    hidden = []
    for o in bpy.context.scene.objects:
        if o in keep or o.type not in ('MESH', 'CURVE'):
            continue
        if not o.hide_render:
            o.hide_render = True
            hidden.append(o)
    return hidden


def _restore(hidden):
    for o in hidden:
        o.hide_render = False


def _bake(obj, image, kind, samples, margin=6):
    """Bake into `image` with every material of `obj` holding it as the
    active image node."""
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    scene.cycles.samples = samples
    scene.render.bake.margin = margin
    scene.render.bake.margin_type = 'EXTEND'
    scene.render.bake.use_clear = True
    scene.render.bake.normal_space = 'TANGENT'
    scene.render.bake.target = 'IMAGE_TEXTURES'
    added = []
    for slot in obj.material_slots:
        mat = slot.material
        if mat is None:
            continue
        nt = mat.node_tree
        tex = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage')
        tex.image = image
        uvn = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeUVMap')
        uvn.uv_map = 'bake'
        nt.links.new(uvn.outputs['UV'], tex.inputs['Vector'])
        nt.nodes.active = tex
        tex.select = True
        added.append((nt, tex, uvn))
    kit.activate(obj)
    obj.data.uv_layers.active = obj.data.uv_layers['bake']
    if kind == 'AO':
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='AO', margin=margin, use_clear=True)
    elif kind == 'NORMAL':
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='NORMAL', margin=margin, use_clear=True, normal_space='TANGENT')
    else:
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='EMIT', margin=margin, use_clear=True)
    for nt, tex, uvn in added:
        nt.nodes.remove(tex)
        nt.nodes.remove(uvn)
    image.pack()


def _flat_override(obj, build):
    """Temporarily give every slot an emission material built by
    `build(graph)`; returns a restore function."""
    originals = [s.material for s in obj.material_slots]
    tmp = bpy.data.materials.new(obj.name + '_tmp')
    g = Graph(tmp)
    build(g)
    for s in obj.material_slots:
        s.material = tmp

    def restore():
        for s, m in zip(obj.material_slots, originals):
            s.material = m
        bpy.data.materials.remove(tmp)
    return restore


def size_for(obj, tpm, lo=256, hi=2048):
    area = sum(p.area for p in obj.data.polygons)
    side = math.sqrt(max(area, 1e-4) * 0.62) * tpm     # ~62% of the atlas is used
    size = 2 ** int(round(math.log2(max(side, lo))))
    return int(max(lo, min(hi, size)))


def bake_model(obj, tpm=110, size=None, ao_distance=0.6, ground=True, bevel=0.012,
               normal_size=None, ao_strength=1.0, emissive=True, seed=None, keep_slots=False,
               samples_ao=32, samples_edge=12, samples_normal=8):
    """Turn a palette-material model into a textured PBR model in place.
    Returns a dict of the images."""
    import surfaces
    t0 = time.time()
    if size is None:
        size = size_for(obj, tpm)
    if FAST:
        size = min(size, 256)
        samples_ao, samples_edge, samples_normal = 4, 2, 1
    nsize = normal_size or size
    name = obj.name
    keys = [(s.material.name if s.material else 'stone') for s in obj.material_slots]
    keys = [k.split('.')[0] for k in keys]
    if not obj.data.uv_layers.get('UVMap'):
        kit.uv_box(obj)
        obj.data.uv_layers[-1].name = 'UVMap'
    unwrap(obj)

    hidden = _isolate([obj])
    plane = None
    if ground:
        mn, mx = kit.bounds(obj)
        span = max(mx.x - mn.x, mx.y - mn.y) * 2 + 4
        plane = kit.plane(span, span, loc=((mn.x + mx.x) / 2, (mn.y + mx.y) / 2, mn.z + 0.002), mat='dirt', name=name + '_ground')
        if mn.z < -0.05:       # sunk rocks: the ground at z = 0
            plane.location.z = 0.0
    world = bpy.context.scene.world or bpy.data.worlds.new('bake_world')
    bpy.context.scene.world = world
    world.use_nodes = True
    world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Color'].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
    world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
    bpy.context.scene.world.light_settings.distance = ao_distance

    # 2. ambient occlusion
    ao = new_image(name + '_ao', size, non_color=True)
    restore = _flat_override(obj, lambda g: g.emission((1, 1, 1)))
    _bake(obj, ao, 'AO', samples_ao)
    restore()
    if plane:
        kit.delete(plane)
    # 3. edge mask from the bevel normal
    edge = new_image(name + '_edge', size, non_color=True)

    def edge_graph(g):
        bev = g.bevel(bevel * 2.5, samples=8)
        n = g.geometry('Normal')
        d = g.vmath('DOT_PRODUCT', bev, n, out=1)
        e = g.map_range(d, 0.995, 0.75, 0.0, 1.0)
        g.emission(g.combine(e, e, e))
    restore = _flat_override(obj, edge_graph)
    _bake(obj, edge, 'EMIT', samples_edge)
    restore()
    blur_image(edge, 1)

    # 4. procedural surfaces
    rnd_seed = seed if seed is not None else (sum(ord(c) for c in name) % 997)
    mats = []
    for k in keys:
        mats.append(surfaces.surface_material(k, ao, edge, seed=rnd_seed, bevel=bevel))
    for slot, m in zip(obj.material_slots, mats):
        slot.material = m

    # 5. channels
    base = new_image(name + '_base', size)
    rough = new_image(name + '_rough', size, non_color=True)
    metal = new_image(name + '_metal', size, non_color=True)
    normal = new_image(name + '_normal', nsize, non_color=True)
    has_glow = emissive and any(surfaces.has_glow(k) for k in keys)
    glow = new_image(name + '_glow', max(256, size // 2)) if has_glow else None

    for img, ch in ((base, 'albedo'), (rough, 'rough'), (metal, 'metal')) + (((glow, 'glow'),) if glow else ()):
        surfaces.route(mats, ch)
        _bake(obj, img, 'EMIT', 1)
    surfaces.route(mats, None)
    _bake(obj, normal, 'NORMAL', samples_normal)

    # 6. the final material
    mr = new_image(name + '_mr', size, non_color=True)
    r, m = pixels(rough), pixels(metal)
    out = np.ones_like(r)
    out[..., 1] = r[..., 0]
    out[..., 2] = m[..., 0]
    set_pixels(mr, out)
    for img in (base, normal):
        img.pack()
    final = baked_material(name, base, normal, mr, glow)
    obj.data.materials.clear()
    obj.data.materials.append(final)
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        p.material_index = 0
    finish_uvs(obj)
    # vertex colours are now in the textures
    kit.flat_color(obj, 1.0)
    for m_ in mats:
        bpy.data.materials.remove(m_)
    for img in (rough, metal):
        bpy.data.images.remove(img)
    _restore(hidden)
    kit.log(f'baked {name}: {size}px ({nsize}px normal){" +glow" if glow else ""} in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s')
    return {'base': base, 'normal': normal, 'mr': mr, 'glow': glow, 'ao': ao, 'edge': edge}


def baked_material(name, base, normal, mr, emissive=None, alpha=False):
    """Principled material wired to baked images (what the glTF exporter reads)."""
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    g = Graph(mat)
    tb = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=base)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tb.inputs['Vector'])
    tn = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=normal)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tn.inputs['Vector'])
    tm = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=mr)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tm.inputs['Vector'])
    nm = g.node('ShaderNodeNormalMap', space='TANGENT', uv_map='bake')
    g.nt.links.new(tn.outputs['Color'], nm.inputs['Color'])
    sep = g.node('ShaderNodeSeparateColor')
    g.nt.links.new(tm.outputs['Color'], sep.inputs['Color'])
    bsdf = g.principled(tb.outputs['Color'], sep.outputs['Green'], sep.outputs['Blue'], nm.outputs[0],
                        alpha=tb.outputs['Alpha'] if alpha else None)
    if emissive is not None:
        te = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=emissive)
        g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), te.inputs['Vector'])
        g.feed(bsdf.inputs['Emission Color'], te.outputs['Color'])
        g.feed(bsdf.inputs['Emission Strength'], 1.0)
    if alpha:
        mat.blend_method = 'CLIP' if hasattr(mat, 'blend_method') else None
    return mat

"""Hedgerow — realistic PBR bakes (models v2).

A model built with kit.py (palette-keyed materials, box UVs in metres
`UVMap`, origin at its base) goes through `bake_model()`:

1. a fresh atlas unwrap into a `bake` UV layer (smart project + pack);
2. ambient occlusion baked from the model itself and a ground plane under
   it (contact darkening) — the AO image;
3. an edge mask: how far the Cycles Bevel normal leans from the true normal,
   i.e. where edges are — the EDGE image (paint chips, worn edges, dust);
4. every palette material replaced by its procedural surface from
   `surfaces.py` (stone courses, mortar, peeling paint, rust, burlap, wool,
   bark, moss, grime, rain streaks...), which reads the AO and EDGE images;
5. base colour, roughness, metallic and emission baked through an emission
   override (noise-free, one sample), the tangent-space normal baked from the
   surfaces' bump plus rounded bevelled edges;
6. one Principled material wired to the images (base colour, normal, packed
   metallic-roughness, optional emissive); the `bake` UVs become `UVMap` so
   they export as TEXCOORD_0.

Export with `kit.export(..., images=True)` (WebP inside the GLB).

    bake.bake_model(obj, tpm=110)          # texels per metre
    bake.bake_model(obj, size=1024)        # or a fixed size

Set HEDGEROW_FAST=1 for quick iterations (small images, few samples).
Deterministic: fixed seeds; Cycles seed fixed by kit.reset().
"""
import bpy, bmesh, math, os, time
import numpy as np
from mathutils import Vector

import kit

FAST = bool(os.environ.get('HEDGEROW_FAST'))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A small shader-graph builder (after fun/meteora/tools/blender/common.py)

class Graph:
    """Helpers over a material node tree. Inputs may be numbers, colours,
    sockets or nodes; every helper returns an output socket."""

    def __init__(self, mat, clear=True):
        self.mat = mat
        mat.use_nodes = True
        self.nt = mat.node_tree
        if clear:
            for n in list(self.nt.nodes):
                self.nt.nodes.remove(n)
        self.output = next((n for n in self.nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == 'ShaderNodeOutputMaterial'), None) \
            or self.nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')

    def feed(self, sock, val):
        if val is None:
            return
        if isinstance(val, bpy.types.Node):
            val = val.outputs[0]
        if isinstance(val, bpy.types.NodeSocket):
            self.nt.links.new(val, sock)
            return
        dv = sock.default_value
        if isinstance(val, (int, float)) and hasattr(dv, '__len__'):
            val = [val] * len(dv)
            if len(dv) == 4:
                val[3] = 1.0
        elif hasattr(dv, '__len__') and len(dv) == 4 and len(val) == 3:
            val = list(val) + [1.0]
        sock.default_value = val

    def node(self, kind, inputs=None, **props):
        n = self.nt.nodes.new(kind)
        for k, v in props.items():
            setattr(n, k, v)
        if inputs:
            items = inputs.items() if isinstance(inputs, dict) else enumerate(inputs)
            for key, val in items:
                self.feed(n.inputs[key], val)
        return n

    # inputs
    def coord(self, kind='Object'):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeTexCoord').outputs[kind]

    def uvmap(self, name):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeUVMap', uv_map=name).outputs['UV']

    def geometry(self, kind):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeNewGeometry').outputs[kind]

    def attribute(self, name, kind='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeAttribute', attribute_name=name)
        return n.outputs[kind]

    def image(self, img, uv='bake', out='Color'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=img, interpolation='Linear')
        self.nt.links.new(self.uvmap(uv), n.inputs['Vector'])
        return n.outputs[out]

    # arithmetic
    def math(self, op, a, b=None, c=None, clamp=False):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMath', operation=op, use_clamp=clamp)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[1], b)
        self.feed(n.inputs[2], c)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def add(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('ADD', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def sub(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('SUBTRACT', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def mul(self, a, b, clamp=False): return self.math('MULTIPLY', a, b, clamp=clamp)
    def madd(self, a, b, c, clamp=False): return self.math('MULTIPLY_ADD', a, b, c, clamp=clamp)
    def maximum(self, a, b): return self.math('MAXIMUM', a, b)
    def minimum(self, a, b): return self.math('MINIMUM', a, b)
    def power(self, a, b): return self.math('POWER', a, b)
    def absolute(self, a): return self.math('ABSOLUTE', a)
    def sin(self, a): return self.math('SINE', a)
    def fract(self, a): return self.math('FRACT', a)
    def floor(self, a): return self.math('FLOOR', a)
    def one_minus(self, a): return self.math('SUBTRACT', 1.0, a)

    def vmath(self, op, a, b=None, scale=None, out=0):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeVectorMath', operation=op)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[1], b)
        if scale is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def vscale(self, v, s):
        """Component-wise scale: s is a number or an (x, y, z) tuple."""
        if isinstance(s, (int, float)):
            return self.vmath('SCALE', v, scale=s)
        return self.vmath('MULTIPLY', v, tuple(s))

    def vadd(self, v, o):
        return self.vmath('ADD', v, tuple(o) if not isinstance(o, bpy.types.NodeSocket) else o)

    def sep(self, v):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ', [v])
        return n.outputs[0], n.outputs[1], n.outputs[2]

    def combine(self, x, y, z):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeCombineXYZ', [x, y, z]).outputs[0]

    def map_range(self, x, a, b, c=0.0, d=1.0, interp='LINEAR', clamp=True):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMapRange', interpolation_type=interp, clamp=clamp)
        for i, v in enumerate((x, a, b, c, d)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[i], v)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def smooth(self, x, a, b):
        return self.map_range(x, a, b, 0.0, 1.0, interp='SMOOTHSTEP')

    def mix(self, fac, a, b, blend='MIX'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMix', data_type='RGBA', blend_type=blend, clamp_factor=True)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        self.feed(n.inputs[6], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[7], b)
        return n.outputs[2]

    def mixf(self, fac, a, b):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeMix', data_type='FLOAT', clamp_factor=True)
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        self.feed(n.inputs[2], a)
        self.feed(n.inputs[3], b)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def cmul(self, a, b):
        return self.mix(1.0, a, b, blend='MULTIPLY')

    def ramp(self, fac, stops, interp='LINEAR'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
        self.feed(n.inputs[0], fac)
        cr = n.color_ramp
        cr.interpolation = interp
        while len(cr.elements) > len(stops):
            cr.elements.remove(cr.elements[-1])
        while len(cr.elements) < len(stops):
            cr.elements.new(0.5)
        for el, (pos, col) in zip(cr.elements, stops):
            el.position = pos
            el.color = tuple(col) + ((1.0,) if len(col) == 3 else ())
        return n.outputs[0]

    def hsv(self, col, h=0.5, s=1.0, v=1.0):
        return self.node('ShaderNodeHueSaturation', {'Hue': h, 'Saturation': s, 'Value': v, 'Fac': 1.0, 'Color': col}).outputs[0]

    # textures
    def noise(self, vec, scale, detail=4.0, rough=0.5, distortion=0.0, kind='FBM', lac=2.0, out='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexNoise', noise_type=kind, noise_dimensions='3D')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        for k, v in (('Scale', scale), ('Detail', detail), ('Roughness', rough),
                     ('Lacunarity', lac), ('Distortion', distortion)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[k], v)
        return n.outputs['Fac' if out in ('Fac', 'Factor') else out]

    def voronoi(self, vec, scale, feature='F1', rand=1.0, out='Distance', smooth=0.0, dims='3D', metric='EUCLIDEAN'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexVoronoi', feature=feature, voronoi_dimensions=dims, distance=metric)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Randomness'], rand)
        if feature == 'SMOOTH_F1':
            self.feed(n.inputs['Smoothness'], smooth)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def voronoi_edge(self, vec, scale, rand=1.0, dims='3D'):
        """Distance to the nearest cell border (0 on the border)."""
        return self.voronoi(vec, scale, feature='DISTANCE_TO_EDGE', rand=rand, dims=dims)

    def brick(self, vec, scale, mortar, width=0.5, height=0.25, bias=0.0, smooth=0.1, offset=0.5, out='Fac'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexBrick', offset=offset, squash=1.0)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        for k, v in (('Scale', scale), ('Mortar Size', mortar), ('Mortar Smooth', smooth),
                     ('Bias', bias), ('Brick Width', width), ('Row Height', height)):
            self.feed(n.inputs[k], v)
        n.inputs['Color1'].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
        n.inputs['Color2'].default_value = (0, 0, 0, 1)
        return n.outputs[out]

    def wave(self, vec, scale, kind='BANDS', direction='X', distortion=0.0, detail=2.0, profile='SIN'):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeTexWave', wave_type=kind, bands_direction=direction, wave_profile=profile)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Vector'], vec)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Scale'], scale)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Distortion'], distortion)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Detail'], detail)
        return n.outputs['Fac']

    def bump(self, height, strength=1.0, distance=0.02, normal=None):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBump')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Height'], height)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Strength'], strength)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Distance'], distance)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Normal'], normal)
        return n.outputs[0]

    def bevel(self, radius, samples=8):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBevel', samples=samples)
        n.inputs['Radius'].default_value = radius
        return n.outputs[0]

    def emission(self, col):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeEmission')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Color'], col)
        n.inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
        self.nt.links.new(n.outputs[0], self.output.inputs['Surface'])
        return n

    def principled(self, albedo, rough, metal, normal=None, glow=None, alpha=None):
        n = self.node('ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled')
        self.feed(n.inputs['Base Color'], albedo)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Roughness'], rough)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Metallic'], metal)
        self.feed(n.inputs['Normal'], normal)
        if glow is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Emission Color'], glow)
            self.feed(n.inputs['Emission Strength'], 1.0)
        if alpha is not None:
            self.feed(n.inputs['Alpha'], alpha)
        self.nt.links.new(n.outputs[0], self.output.inputs['Surface'])
        return n


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Images

def new_image(name, size, non_color=False, alpha=False):
    old = bpy.data.images.get(name)
    if old:
        bpy.data.images.remove(old)
    img = bpy.data.images.new(name, size, size, alpha=alpha, float_buffer=False)
    if non_color:
        img.colorspace_settings.name = 'Non-Color'
    return img


def pixels(img):
    a = np.empty(len(img.pixels), np.float32)
    img.pixels.foreach_get(a)
    return a.reshape(img.size[1], img.size[0], 4)


def set_pixels(img, arr):
    img.pixels.foreach_set(np.ascontiguousarray(arr, np.float32).ravel())
    img.update()
    img.pack()


def blur_image(img, r=1):
    a = pixels(img)
    out = a.copy()
    acc = np.zeros_like(a)
    n = 0
    for dy in range(-r, r + 1):
        for dx in range(-r, r + 1):
            acc += np.roll(np.roll(a, dy, 0), dx, 1)
            n += 1
    out[..., :3] = acc[..., :3] / n
    set_pixels(img, out)
    return img


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UVs

def unwrap(obj, margin=0.004, angle=62.0):
    """A fresh atlas unwrap into a `bake` UV layer (kept beside `UVMap`)."""
    me = obj.data
    if 'bake' in me.uv_layers:
        me.uv_layers.remove(me.uv_layers['bake'])
    lay = me.uv_layers.new(name='bake')
    me.uv_layers.active = lay
    kit.activate(obj)
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
    bpy.ops.mesh.select_all(action='SELECT')
    bpy.ops.uv.smart_project(angle_limit=math.radians(angle), island_margin=margin,
                             area_weight=0.0, correct_aspect=True, scale_to_bounds=False)
    bpy.ops.uv.select_all(action='SELECT')
    try:
        bpy.ops.uv.pack_islands(rotate=True, rotate_method='ANY', shape_method='CONCAVE',
                                margin_method='FRACTION', margin=margin)
    except TypeError:
        bpy.ops.uv.pack_islands(rotate=True, margin=margin)
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
    return lay


def finish_uvs(obj):
    """After baking: the atlas becomes the only UV layer, named UVMap."""
    me = obj.data
    for lay in list(me.uv_layers):
        if lay.name != 'bake':
            me.uv_layers.remove(lay)
    me.uv_layers['bake'].name = 'UVMap'
    me.uv_layers.active = me.uv_layers['UVMap']
    me.uv_layers['UVMap'].active_render = True


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Baking

def _isolate(objs):
    """Hide every other renderable object while baking these."""
    keep = set(objs)
    hidden = []
    for o in bpy.context.scene.objects:
        if o in keep or o.type not in ('MESH', 'CURVE'):
            continue
        if not o.hide_render:
            o.hide_render = True
            hidden.append(o)
    return hidden


def _restore(hidden):
    for o in hidden:
        o.hide_render = False


def _bake(obj, image, kind, samples, margin=6):
    """Bake into `image` with every material of `obj` holding it as the
    active image node."""
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    scene.cycles.samples = samples
    scene.render.bake.margin = margin
    scene.render.bake.margin_type = 'EXTEND'
    scene.render.bake.use_clear = True
    scene.render.bake.normal_space = 'TANGENT'
    scene.render.bake.target = 'IMAGE_TEXTURES'
    added = []
    for slot in obj.material_slots:
        mat = slot.material
        if mat is None:
            continue
        nt = mat.node_tree
        tex = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage')
        tex.image = image
        uvn = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeUVMap')
        uvn.uv_map = 'bake'
        nt.links.new(uvn.outputs['UV'], tex.inputs['Vector'])
        nt.nodes.active = tex
        tex.select = True
        added.append((nt, tex, uvn))
    kit.activate(obj)
    obj.data.uv_layers.active = obj.data.uv_layers['bake']
    if kind == 'AO':
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='AO', margin=margin, use_clear=True)
    elif kind == 'NORMAL':
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='NORMAL', margin=margin, use_clear=True, normal_space='TANGENT')
    else:
        bpy.ops.object.bake(type='EMIT', margin=margin, use_clear=True)
    for nt, tex, uvn in added:
        nt.nodes.remove(tex)
        nt.nodes.remove(uvn)
    image.pack()


def _flat_override(obj, build):
    """Temporarily give every slot an emission material built by
    `build(graph)`; returns a restore function."""
    originals = [s.material for s in obj.material_slots]
    tmp = bpy.data.materials.new(obj.name + '_tmp')
    g = Graph(tmp)
    build(g)
    for s in obj.material_slots:
        s.material = tmp

    def restore():
        for s, m in zip(obj.material_slots, originals):
            s.material = m
        bpy.data.materials.remove(tmp)
    return restore


def size_for(obj, tpm, lo=256, hi=2048):
    area = sum(p.area for p in obj.data.polygons)
    side = math.sqrt(max(area, 1e-4) * 0.62) * tpm     # ~62% of the atlas is used
    size = 2 ** int(round(math.log2(max(side, lo))))
    return int(max(lo, min(hi, size)))


def bake_model(obj, tpm=110, size=None, ao_distance=0.6, ground=True, bevel=0.012,
               normal_size=None, ao_strength=1.0, emissive=True, seed=None, keep_slots=False,
               samples_ao=32, samples_edge=12, samples_normal=8):
    """Turn a palette-material model into a textured PBR model in place.
    Returns a dict of the images."""
    import surfaces
    t0 = time.time()
    if size is None:
        size = size_for(obj, tpm)
    if FAST:
        size = min(size, 256)
        samples_ao, samples_edge, samples_normal = 4, 2, 1
    nsize = normal_size or size
    name = obj.name
    keys = [(s.material.name if s.material else 'stone') for s in obj.material_slots]
    keys = [k.split('.')[0] for k in keys]
    if not obj.data.uv_layers.get('UVMap'):
        kit.uv_box(obj)
        obj.data.uv_layers[-1].name = 'UVMap'
    unwrap(obj)

    hidden = _isolate([obj])
    plane = None
    if ground:
        mn, mx = kit.bounds(obj)
        span = max(mx.x - mn.x, mx.y - mn.y) * 2 + 4
        plane = kit.plane(span, span, loc=((mn.x + mx.x) / 2, (mn.y + mx.y) / 2, mn.z + 0.002), mat='dirt', name=name + '_ground')
        if mn.z < -0.05:       # sunk rocks: the ground at z = 0
            plane.location.z = 0.0
    world = bpy.context.scene.world or bpy.data.worlds.new('bake_world')
    bpy.context.scene.world = world
    world.use_nodes = True
    world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Color'].default_value = (1, 1, 1, 1)
    world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
    bpy.context.scene.world.light_settings.distance = ao_distance

    # 2. ambient occlusion
    ao = new_image(name + '_ao', size, non_color=True)
    restore = _flat_override(obj, lambda g: g.emission((1, 1, 1)))
    _bake(obj, ao, 'AO', samples_ao)
    restore()
    if plane:
        kit.delete(plane)
    # 3. edge mask from the bevel normal
    edge = new_image(name + '_edge', size, non_color=True)

    def edge_graph(g):
        bev = g.bevel(bevel * 2.5, samples=8)
        n = g.geometry('Normal')
        d = g.vmath('DOT_PRODUCT', bev, n, out=1)
        e = g.map_range(d, 0.995, 0.75, 0.0, 1.0)
        g.emission(g.combine(e, e, e))
    restore = _flat_override(obj, edge_graph)
    _bake(obj, edge, 'EMIT', samples_edge)
    restore()
    blur_image(edge, 1)

    # 4. procedural surfaces
    rnd_seed = seed if seed is not None else (sum(ord(c) for c in name) % 997)
    mats = []
    for k in keys:
        mats.append(surfaces.surface_material(k, ao, edge, seed=rnd_seed, bevel=bevel))
    for slot, m in zip(obj.material_slots, mats):
        slot.material = m

    # 5. channels
    base = new_image(name + '_base', size)
    rough = new_image(name + '_rough', size, non_color=True)
    metal = new_image(name + '_metal', size, non_color=True)
    normal = new_image(name + '_normal', nsize, non_color=True)
    has_glow = emissive and any(surfaces.has_glow(k) for k in keys)
    glow = new_image(name + '_glow', max(256, size // 2)) if has_glow else None

    for img, ch in ((base, 'albedo'), (rough, 'rough'), (metal, 'metal')) + (((glow, 'glow'),) if glow else ()):
        surfaces.route(mats, ch)
        _bake(obj, img, 'EMIT', 1)
    surfaces.route(mats, None)
    _bake(obj, normal, 'NORMAL', samples_normal)

    # 6. the final material
    mr = new_image(name + '_mr', size, non_color=True)
    r, m = pixels(rough), pixels(metal)
    out = np.ones_like(r)
    out[..., 1] = r[..., 0]
    out[..., 2] = m[..., 0]
    set_pixels(mr, out)
    for img in (base, normal):
        img.pack()
    final = baked_material(name, base, normal, mr, glow)
    obj.data.materials.clear()
    obj.data.materials.append(final)
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        p.material_index = 0
    finish_uvs(obj)
    # vertex colours are now in the textures
    kit.flat_color(obj, 1.0)
    for m_ in mats:
        bpy.data.materials.remove(m_)
    for img in (rough, metal):
        bpy.data.images.remove(img)
    _restore(hidden)
    kit.log(f'baked {name}: {size}px ({nsize}px normal){" +glow" if glow else ""} in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s')
    return {'base': base, 'normal': normal, 'mr': mr, 'glow': glow, 'ao': ao, 'edge': edge}


def baked_material(name, base, normal, mr, emissive=None, alpha=False):
    """Principled material wired to baked images (what the glTF exporter reads)."""
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    g = Graph(mat)
    tb = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=base)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tb.inputs['Vector'])
    tn = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=normal)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tn.inputs['Vector'])
    tm = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=mr)
    g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), tm.inputs['Vector'])
    nm = g.node('ShaderNodeNormalMap', space='TANGENT', uv_map='bake')
    g.nt.links.new(tn.outputs['Color'], nm.inputs['Color'])
    sep = g.node('ShaderNodeSeparateColor')
    g.nt.links.new(tm.outputs['Color'], sep.inputs['Color'])
    bsdf = g.principled(tb.outputs['Color'], sep.outputs['Green'], sep.outputs['Blue'], nm.outputs[0],
                        alpha=tb.outputs['Alpha'] if alpha else None)
    if emissive is not None:
        te = g.node('ShaderNodeTexImage', image=emissive)
        g.nt.links.new(g.uvmap('bake'), te.inputs['Vector'])
